entry.title: New: Bill 51 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 24, ARTICLE 10, DIVISION 1, OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO SPEED LIMITS

Amends Section 24-256, Schedule 3 by adding Kalanianaʻole Street, James Kealoha Park Access Road to Leleiwi Street to decrease the speed limit from 30 to 25 miles per hour, and removes the same from Section 24-256, Schedule 4.

Latest action: Council: Bill 51 passes second & final reading - 08/02/23
